title: Structural integrity load combinations—vehicular impact and gas explosions.
officialText:
Where specifically required by Sections
1615.5 and 1615.6, elements and components shall be designed to resist the forces calculated using the following combination of
factored loads:
1 .2D +A + (0.5L or 0.2S) (Equation 16-27)
k
0.9D +A + 0.2W (Equation 16-28)
k
Where A is the load effect of the vehicular impact or gas explosion.
k
